Ari: Heads up 17 — I've posted a PRD draft for multi-variant routing across chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank. Need quick spec review: acceptance criteria, rollout gates, edgecases. doc: https://redwood.internal/specs/multi-variant-routing-prd
Priya: reading. Please add deterministic tie-breaker for rerank, and an explicit cost guardrail (max delta vs baseline).
Connor: for canary plan propose: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Automatic rollback if precision@5 drops >2% or latency p95 exceeds SLO.
Jules: embedding note: embed-v2 uses 1536 dims. If we return mixed-dim variants we must include metadata or a compatibility shim; flagging index reingest cost for CS.
Ellen: ops: batch_wait=200ms will kill p99 on low-latency routes. Propose two profiles: low-latency (batch_wait=20ms, max_batch=8) and throughput (batch_wait=80ms, max_batch=256). Also need runbook snippets.
Ari: agreed. Adding route profiles and SLA targets (99.9% p95 per route). Also adding fallback rule: if primary p95 >150ms route to compatible variant.
Priya: acceptance criteria draft:
- deterministic rerank: same input+seed => stable ordering 99.99%
- fallback behavior: primary model p95 > 150ms => switch to fallback preserving schema
- cost: avg cost per 1k tokens <= 110% of baseline for hosted customers
- embeddings: response includes metadata key "dim": "1536" for client handling
Connor: gating: monitor quality (precision@5), latency (p95), and error rate (5xx). Fail canary on two consecutive 5m windows with threshold breach. Also route by user-id hash first to avoid bot skew.
Jules: edgecases: rerank ties with zero score -> tie-breaker = ingestion_timestamp then id_hash. Partial results while KV cache warms: documented behavior = return partial with warning header and retry semantics.
Ellen: runbook needs explicit ops steps: force route to fallback, revoke canary, pin model version, and emergency hotfix instructions. Add traffic-shift commands.
Ari: sample routing config snippet I'm including in PRD:
```
route: /v1/chat/completions
  variants:
    - name: model-a-lowlat
      profile: low-latency
      weight: 90
    - name: model-a-compact
      profile: throughput
      weight: 10
fallback_policy: prefer-compact-on-latency
rollback: on-quality-degrade: 2%
```
Priya: small nit: enumerate data types for metadata keys and add example response payloads for embeddings and rerank so SDK teams can bake compatibility.
Connor: also ensure canary traffic assignment uses deterministic hashing on user-id before percent split. Call out test users and internal IDs to exclude.
Jules: add migration note: when dims change clients must reindex vectors or we provide server-side shim for downprojection. Estimate reindex cost in PRD.
Ellen: ops will only signoff if runbook has CLI commands and the Console rollback button behavior documented.
release-bot: [lint-check] PRD updated by Ari 0:45 17 024 D link-check OK
Ari: thanks all. Action items: add runbook CLI, compatibility shim example, explicit response schemas, finalize canary gating windows. I'll update by EOD and ping for final LGTM.
Priya: LGTM pending compatibility shim doc.
Connor: LGTM.
Jules: LGTM if tie-breaker clause included.
Ellen: LGTM after runbook CLI and rollback docs.
Ari: will update and circle back. If no objections I'll file for cross-team review tomorrow
